selection.openai: English objective typo predicate: 28/30 vs 23/30. Accepts recall tradeoff 13/15 vs 15/15; no claim of lower input cost.
selection.typesafe: Retain original criteria; shorten redundant question. On development, threshold 0.35 (grid step 0.05, lowest best-accuracy threshold) removes the normal ID4 false positive without new false negatives: 29/30, recalculated from probabilities. Raw run threshold was 0.25, 28/30. One missed typo ID22 remains.
selection.correction: Preserve v3 policy, output edits, reasoning_effort=low. Both models 30/30 on development. Reject none: invalid no-op edits or overcorrection. Reject compact policy: lower strict accuracy.
selection.evaluation: Holdout prompts, thresholds and gold will not be changed after evaluation. It contains 24 new synthetic cases (12 pairs), not 48 independent cases.
